summary: Cargo tree rejected proc-macro as an edge-kind value
details: The first bounded Cargo tree invocation passed `-e normal,build,proc-macro,features`; Cargo 1.98.1 returned exit code 1 and listed supported edge kinds without `proc-macro`. No source or cache mutation resulted. The corrected locked offline trees used `--edges all` plus `--edges normal,build,features`; Cargo's output marks procedural macro packages and feature activation. Both target metadata commands and corrected trees completed within the command and aggregate time bounds.
action: Retained the rejection output and exit code, corrected the Cargo tree arguments, and kept the successful output identities in the audit evidence.
outcome: Native and wasm metadata and corrected tree evidence are available; the unsupported invocation remains an explicit failed command outcome.
